# Bootstrap Icons

This sprite contains the eleven icons used by HMS, extracted without path changes
from Bootstrap Icons v1.13.1:
https://github.com/twbs/icons/releases/tag/v1.13.1

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/twbs/icons/v1.13.1/bootstrap-icons.svg
License: MIT, reproduced in LICENSE in this directory.

The application serves these assets locally and makes no icon CDN requests.
